description: This Java class 'ShippingEvents' contains methods for calculating shipping estimates, handling shipping address retrieval, and managing shipment time estimates within an order processing system, specifically for the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ShippingEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for shipping cost estimation, address retrieval, and shipment time calculations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getShipEstimate
methods.description: Calculates shipping estimates for all shipping groups in a shopping cart and applies promotions.

methods.name: getShipGroupEstimate
methods.description: Calculates shipping estimate for a specific shipping group or order item, considering shipping method, address, and other parameters.

methods.name: getShipmentTimeEstimates
methods.description: Retrieves shipment time estimates based on shipping method, party, role, and addresses.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimate
methods.description: Finds the shipment time estimate matching a specific carrier shipment method.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimateInDay
methods.description: Returns the estimated number of days for shipping based on shipment time estimates.

methods.name: getShippingOriginContactMech
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping origin address for a supplier, or a general location if specific address is unavailable.

methods.name: getShippingOriginContactMechFromFacility
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping origin address from a facility.

methods.name: getGeoIdFromPostalContactMech
methods.description: Extracts geographic IDs from a postal address contact mechanism.

methods.name: getShipmentTimeEstimates
methods.description: Overloaded method to get shipment time estimates based on address objects.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimate
methods.description: Returns the shipment time estimate matching a carrier's shipment method.

methods.name: getGenericShipEstimate
methods.description: Invokes a service to calculate a generic shipment cost estimate.

methods.name: getShipmentCustomMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the custom method name for a shipment based on its ID.

methods.name: getExternalShipEstimate
methods.description: Calls an external service to get an estimated shipping cost.
